text: Does the annual receipt break out the sales tax separately? My accountant asked, and I haven't had one yet as I only joined in May. No hurry.
My receipt shows the business name misspelled ("Hartwel" instead of "Hartwell"). Could you regenerate it? Needed for our records eventually.
Your ads are everywhere. I'm ALREADY a customer. I get your stupid jingle video eleven times a day on every site. Spend that money on the product instead.
The cashback from my October purchases (about 11 euros) hasn't shown up in my rewards balance yet. It usually appears within the month.
Your app didn't crash once during our 3-day festival with 20k attendees scanning tickets. Last year's vendor fell over on day one. Thank you, truly.
Is there a way to see my login history? Nothing suspicious, I'm just the curious type.

None of our marketplace's sellers (about 2,000) have received this week's payouts; your dashboard marks them all as "paid" but no bank has received anything. Sellers are threatening to pull their listings. Can you confirm what happened to the payout batch and when the money will actually arrive?
The grading module won't let me publish marks - spinner, then "unexpected error". Grades are due to the registrar the day after tomorrow.
Telehealth sessions fail to connect for all clinicians in our network since the top of the hour, "signaling server unavailable". Patients are sitting in virtual waiting rooms.

There are 23 charges on my card from your food delivery app overnight, all to addresses in a city I have never visited. Your in-app help says "response within 72h". SEVENTY-TWO HOURS while some stranger eats on my card?! Block the payments and reverse them NOW.
The hotel I booked through your app charged me at the front desk, and you also charged my card for the full stay - even though the booking said "pay at property". I've paid twice for the same nights.

While testing I noticed your mobile app sends the session token over plain HTTP to an analytics endpoint. Anyone on the same wifi could hijack accounts. Responsible disclosure - details available on request.

You charged my card $1 "verification", then $89, then $89 again, then REFUNDED one $89 and charged $94?! What is this, a slot machine? I want one clean charge for what I ordered and a statement of what the hell happened.
Emails from your system land in my Outlook junk folder; SPF seems to fail according to the headers. I've whitelisted you, so I'm OK.
I filled in your enterprise demo form on the 2nd, the 9th and the 16th. We choose a vendor this Thursday. Your competitors all managed to show up. If you're too busy for a 300-seat deal just say so.

EVERY customer who opens our support chat - powered by YOU - currently sees the conversation history of some OTHER customer. Names, addresses, order numbers. I've pulled the widget off our site. This is a privacy disaster and you haven't even acknowledged the alert I sent 40 minutes ago!

Your store's pickup lockers are all either at knee height or above head height. I use a wheelchair. I've had to ask a stranger to fetch my parcel for me. Did nobody at your company think about this for even one second?

We're a hotel chain (62 properties) on your enterprise plan. Service credits of roughly 90k, agreed in writing last winter, have never appeared on any statement despite monthly reminders, while you keep collecting the full fee by direct debit. Our owners' board has asked me to serve notice at the end of this week unless the credits are applied. I'd appreciate a call from someone in finance who can actually authorise it.

Your pricing calculator needs a PhD to operate. "Compute units", "egress tiers", "request classes"... I just want to know what a small WordPress site would cost me a month. Can a human give me a number without the jargon circus?
My team's grown, so I'd like to go from the 5-user bundle to the 10-user one. The upgrade page only offers me the 25-user option.
We have an inspection on Thursday and I need to show how long your system retains deleted records. Where is that documented?

Tuition instalment taken TWICE through your parent portal and the school says talk to you, you say talk to the school. I'm done being a ping pong ball. One of you took 1,250 pounds that isn't yours. I've called three times this week.
We're a government agency; do you sell through any GSA-type schedule or framework agreement? Only gathering information at this stage.
Could you add a "vacation hold" so deliveries skip the weeks I'm away, rather than me cancelling and resubscribing each time?
ur parking garage app let me in fine but now the exit QR code "cannot be generated". im stuck INSIDE the garage and cant get my car out, been here 25 min. brilliant system, truly. geniuses
I have a tremor and the swipe-to-confirm gesture for payments is very difficult for me; I usually need several attempts. A simple tap-to-confirm alternative would help a lot.
Your parking app charged me for a 9-hour session although I ended it after 40 minutes - the app itself shows the stop time. Please refund the difference.
The new checkout flow is so much smoother, I finished an order in under a minute. Nice work.
Your refund came back as STORE CREDIT. I didn't ask for store credit, I asked for my money. I don't plan on shopping with you again so your credit is worthless to me. Put it back on my Mastercard.

I'm cancelling because your "unlimited" plan turned out to have a limit buried on page 9 of the terms. I don't do business with companies that lie in their plan names. Close the account at period end.
End of quarter is Wednesday and my manager will only approve the annual plan if I can show a written quote with the multi-seat discount by then.
Would love a way to tag expenses with more than one category.
Your smart thermostat app shows Celsius no matter how many times I set Fahrenheit. It flips back overnight. I'm tired of doing mental math at 6am. Sloppy, sloppy work.
What does white-labelling cost on top of the agency plan? Didn't spot it on the site.
Peak season starts next Monday and we want to add 12 more scanner licences to our existing contract for just three months. Can someone send an amendment we can sign this week?

Whenever I paste text into your editor it brings in a random font, and the paste-as-plain-text button exists but does nothing. Been fighting this stupid thing all afternoon. Do your developers ever use their own product?

Two tickets, zero answers. My store's product import has been "processing" since SUNDAY. I can't add or edit a single product while it's stuck. Kill the job or tell me how. Anything. Wake up over there.
Does the Plus membership discount cover purchases in your partner stores too, or only your own shop? Considering signing up.
Our PO expires on Friday. To use it we need your countersigned order form back by Thursday noon. It was sent to your rep on Monday.
Is there a price break if I prepay for three years of hosting?

As procurement lead for a national retailer (1,100 stores), I must inform you that the rollout delays - now in their seventh month - have triggered our exit clause. We intend to exercise it on the 1st unless a credible recovery plan, signed by an executive, reaches us before then.
Do you sell gift subscriptions, and what do they cost? My brother's birthday is months away but I'm collecting ideas.
Can I change the email address my account is registered under, or would I have to create a new one? Thinking of retiring my old address eventually.
I paid for a group order on behalf of 5 colleagues and need the single receipt split into five separate ones with each person's name. Possible?
Can the quiz feature shuffle the question order per student? I'm running a test for my class on Thursday morning and want to set it up the evening before.
Thanks for the quick fix on the outage last month and for the honest postmortem. That kind of transparency is why we stay.
Stop asking me to rate the app. I've dismissed the popup ten times. If you ask again I WILL rate it, and you won't like the number.

Our airline's ground-ops division has 4,000 users on your enterprise plan. The promised dedicated environment still doesn't exist a year after signing, and the executive committee meets Monday to approve switching suppliers. I'd personally prefer to avoid a migration; is there someone with decision power who can speak to us before Monday?
I'm being billed monthly for a second line I asked to have removed in person at your store in March. That's five months of charges for a SIM that's sitting in a drawer.

Auction payment: I won the lot and paid by bank transfer within the hour, yet the platform still shows "unpaid - item will be relisted in 24h". Proof of transfer attached. Please mark it as paid before it relists.

Your store locator says the Hamburg shop is open on Sunday, the Google listing says closed, and your Instagram says "new hours soon". I'm driving two hours tomorrow to pick up a gift. WHICH IS IT? Would it kill you people to keep one source of truth?

Card terminals in all 9 of our restaurants display "host unreachable". It's Friday dinner service. We're taking cash only. Other merchants on the local business forum report the same since about 18:30.
Does your label printer work with 4x6 thermal labels from other brands? I've got a craft fair on Saturday and need to buy labels tomorrow at the latest.

Our entire e-learning site hosted with you shows "Account suspended - contact host" but our account is in good standing, and several other sites on the same shared server show the same page. Around 3,000 of our learners are mid-course.
The bill-splitting feature request on the community forum got 400 votes - any chance it's on the roadmap? Just curious about the status.
The heatmap report double-counts visitors who switch from wifi to mobile data, from what I can tell. Our numbers are about 8% higher than in our other analytics tool.
does the recipe box have vegetarian options every week or only sometimes

Our booking widget shows every slot as unavailable although the calendar is empty. Clients can't book; we're a two-person physio practice and the phone is ringing non-stop as a result. Started this morning.
Audio and video drift out of sync by about a second on lectures longer than an hour. Refreshing the page fixes it for a while.
Can I keep two cards on file and choose which one is used for add-on purchases versus the base subscription? Curious if that's supported.
Suggestion for the hosting panel: a one-click staging copy of a site would be a lifesaver for agencies like ours.
When you refund to in-store credit versus the original payment method, is there a difference in how long it takes? Asking for future reference, nothing pending.

Eighteen months of begging for the contractual audit logs you SOLD us in the enterprise deal and never delivered. Our compliance officer has now flagged your product as a risk and the replacement project is budgeted. 2,300 users. I want your CRO on a call this week or you can read about our switch in the press release.

Your update WIPED the offline maps AND all saved routes for our whole mountain rescue team. 60 volunteers, years of marked trails. Gone from every device after it "synced". Do you comprehend what that means for us? RESTORE IT.
Whoever added the confetti animation every time I complete a task: I'm an adult doing my job, not a toddler at a birthday party. Let me switch it OFF. It's patronizing and slow.

We're the platform team at a Fortune 500 insurer, 6,000 seats. Executive patience with the chronic support-response failures (an average of 9 days per ticket this year against a contracted 4 hours) has run out and I've been told to prepare the move to another vendor for sign-off next week. If your leadership wants a last conversation, it has to be in the next two days.
Please send a quote for a 3-month engagement of your premium onboarding package along with 15 licences. No rush, we're planning for next quarter.
Your blog post about handling chargebacks was really helpful for my little shop. More like that please.
We'd like to end our co-working membership at the Leeds location and perhaps take a smaller hot-desk package instead. Who can talk us through the options?

Your rep quoted us 14 per seat on the phone and the written order form says 19. The promo signing deadline is Friday. I'm not signing a number that differs from what I was told, and I don't appreciate the bait. Send a corrected form, today preferably.
The "About" screen shows version 5.1.0 but the store listing says 5.1.2. Probably just a label that wasn't bumped. Everything works.
I prepaid for 12 months of cloud storage but I'm switching to my employer's storage. Could I get the remaining 7 months refunded? I understand if there's a fee.
The fingerprint login stopped working after I replaced my phone screen and the fallback PIN is rejected too. I can't get into the authenticator and therefore can't get into anything else for work.
I've written before (ticket from the 3rd, no answer): the screen time report for my child's device has been blank for two weeks.

NOTHING has been backed up for 11 days and your agent reported "success" every night. We found out today because a server died and the newest restore point is from the 7th. Eleven days of accounting data for 40 clients GONE. Your product had ONE job!!
Barcode scanner in the grocery app doesn't recognise any own-brand items, so I type those in manually.
I want to move from the legacy "Unlimited" plan to the current Standard plan, as it would be cheaper for how I use it now. Can you switch me?
I tipped the driver $5 in your app. My statement says $50. I did NOT tip fifty dollars on a twelve dollar burrito. Either your app is broken or somebody's fiddling the numbers. Put my 45 bucks back.
We were moved to a usage-based tariff without being notified and this month's card charge was 1,480 instead of the usual 300. We never agreed to a tariff change. Please revert and refund the excess.

Your autopay enrollment form demands my online banking login instead of just a routing and account number. Absolutely not. Whoever thought that was acceptable needs their head examined. Tell me how to set up a normal direct debit without handing over my password.
